datasetVersion: Supplementary Data 1 (41467_2018_5997_MOESM4_ESM.xlsx; sheets M9_TTS and Rich_TTS), article published 2018-09-10, retrieved 2026-09-16; gene symbols and current locus tags from the NCBI RefSeq NC_000913.3 GenBank file (LOCUS date 09-DEC-2025)

notes: Records: 631 of 666 distinct TSS-TTS pairs. Removed as likely rRNA processing fragments: 35 pairs that start inside a 23S rRNA gene more than 10 nt past its 5' end and end 0 or 8 nt from that gene's annotated 3' end (rrlA 5, rrlC 7, rrlD 5, rrlE 4, rrlG 9, rrlH 5); they are processed rRNA, not primary transcripts. 2 retired b-numbers were replaced by the current locus tag that lists them as /gene_synonym in the GenBank file (b1416->b4493, b1417->b4493); a list that then named the same locus twice keeps it once. Not kept in records.json (reproducible from the build script): per-condition read counts at the TSS, from TSS to TTS, through and past the TTS, and median read-through length; score is the sum of TSS-to-TTS reads over the conditions where the pair was seen. Supplementary Data 1 columns 10-12 (TTS type novelTTS/terminator/attenuator, nearest_known_TTS, center_of_nearest_known_TTS) classify each TTS by distance to EcoCyc-annotated terminators and copy EcoCyc identifiers, so they are never read. Supplementary Data 2 (3,070 operon rows) is not used for unit records: it has no 3' end, condition or read count, and its columns 4-5 are a RegulonDB comparison. Supplementary Data 3 (RegulonDB operons extended by SMRT-Cappable-seq) is never downloaded. Supplementary Data 4 (per-gene counts) is not a feature table.
